## LOAD PACKAGES

```{r, results='hide', message=FALSE}

library(readxl)
library(car)
library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)
library(parallel)
library(broom)
library(broom.helpers)

```

## READ IN DATA

```{r, results='hide', message=FALSE}

## Load complete analytic dataset (HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9_Includedsubset) from 01_DataManage_Exclusion.qmd file
complete_subset <- readRDS("NewData/HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9_Includedsubset202617Jun.RDS")
dim(complete_subset)

```

## LOAD IN FUNCTIONS

```{r}

source('ELE_DNAm_functions.R')

```

## DEFINE MODEL EXPOSURES, OUTCOMES, AND COVARIATES

```{r}

## DEMOGRAPHIC
  ## Define variables
exposure_vars <- c("childrural_democoggen", "SCHLYRS_rev", "LIVEGPAR_R", "CHSMOKE_R")
outcome_vars <- c("GRIM_residuals", "LEVINE_residuals", "MPOA_residuals", "HORVATH_residuals", "HANNUM_residuals")
outcome_vars_gm <- c("globalmethylation", "Island_mean", "OpenSea_mean", "Shelf_mean", "Shore_mean")
  ## Define model covariates
covars_c <- c("age", "sex", "raceethnicity_collapsed", "GR", "NK", "B", "CD8", "CD4", "Sample_Plate") 


## HEALTH 
  ## Define model covariates
covars_health <- c("age", "sex", "raceethnicity_collapsed", "HIBP_latest", "DIAB_latest", "VIGACT_collapsed", "GR", "NK", "B", "CD8", "CD4", "Sample_Plate") 

```


## DEMOGRAPHIC

### Age Acceleration

```{r}

## Create combinations of all outcomes and exposures
var_combinations_c <- func_var_combinations(exposure_vars, outcome_vars)

## Run the adjusted linear regression models and save results in new df
adjusted_c <- run_linear_models(var_combinations_c, data = complete_subset, covars = covars_c)
adjusted_mH_summaries_c <- models_summarize(var_combinations_c, adjusted_c)

# Save as new dataframe
saveRDS(adjusted_c, file = "Model_Diagnostics/adjusted_AAdemographic20262003.RDS")

## Export the data frame
writexl::write_xlsx(adjusted_mH_summaries_c, "Output/Sensitivity/Adjusted_demographic_AA20262003.xlsx")

#Separate model summaries and vif for export
adj_demo_AA <- adjusted_mH_summaries_c$model_summaries
adj_demo_AA_vif <- adjusted_mH_summaries_c$vif

```

### Global Methylation

```{r}
## Create combinations of all outcomes and exposures
var_combinations_gmc <- func_var_combinations(exposure_vars, outcome_vars_gm)

## Run the adjusted linear regression models and save results in new df
adjusted_gmc <- run_linear_models(var_combinations_gmc, data = complete_subset, covars = covars_c)
adjusted_gmH_summaries_c <- models_summarize(var_combinations_gmc, adjusted_gmc)

# Save as new dataframe
saveRDS(adjusted_gmc, file = "Model_Diagnostics/adjusted_GMdemographic20262003.RDS")

## Export the data frame
writexl::write_xlsx(adjusted_gmH_summaries_c, "Output/Sensitivity/Adjusted_demographic_GM20262003.xlsx")

#Separate model summaries and vif for export
adj_demo_GM <- adjusted_gmH_summaries_c$model_summaries
adj_demo_GM_vif <- adjusted_gmH_summaries_c$vif

```


## HEALTH 

### Age Acceleration

```{r}

```

### Global Methylation


## EXPORT RESULTS

```{r}

## write results to single files
sheets_dnamagesensAAGM = list('Demographic (AA)' = adj_demo_AA,
                              'Demographic (GM)' = adj_demo_GM,
                              'Health (AA)' = adj_health_AA,
                              'Health (GM)' = adj_health_GM)
writexl::write_xlsx(sheets_dnamagesensAAGM, 'Output/Sensitivity/Adjusted_DEMOGRAPHIC_HEALTH_AA-GM20262003.xlsx')

```
